text: Need a better way to handle running timed quizzes and automatic submission cutoffs in Google Forms, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord?
Watch FormTimer in action: Choose 15, 30, 45, 60, or 90-minute exam windows—or schedule an exact date and time—to close form submissions automatically on the dot.

Zero external wrapper websites or iframe redirects. Students open the normal Google Form inside Google Classroom with zero authentication errors. Plus, display a clear, tailored message the moment time expires and inspect exact submission timestamps inside your connected response sheet.
Student names, emails, and test scores never touch an external proctoring cloud—and you never hit a mid-finals monthly test quota.
Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
